what: SkyWynn CLASS tree node icons (one 64 x 64 item icon per Skill Trees 3 class node) - DRAFT v1, not wired in yet
same_rules_as: manifest.json (the Mining set): 64 x 64, hard alpha, 1 px outline, light top left, no pure black / white

damage.label: DAMAGE / VULNERABILITY
damage.why: style guide 15: the Fire element (orange) - same as the Mining sheet

health.label: HEALTH / HEAL / LEECH / LESS DAMAGE TAKEN
health.why: style guide 15: the red stat colour = Health

ward.label: WARD / SHIELD
ward.why: style guide 15: the stat-name soft white (defence)

speed.label: MOVE SPEED / HASTE
speed.why: style guide 15: the Air element (white-teal) - same as Mining

ability.label: ABILITY SHAPE (RADIUS / DURATION / COOLDOWN / CHAIN / ECHO)
ability.why: the ability blue of the Mining sheet

control.label: CROWD CONTROL (SLOW / STUN / ROOT / KNOCKBACK / PULL)
control.why: style guide 15: the Thunder element (yellow) = stun stars

resource.label: MANA / STAMINA / COST
resource.why: the arcane violet of the Mage / Spellblade mana ramps

mod_mark.what: small pink rune diamond in the top-left corner = a modifier-type node (hook 'mod'); Skyy 2026-10-23 (docs/answered/classes.md): those are cut / renamed in a later round

reused: free-row ability nodes keep their approved ability icon (art/ability-icons/<file>) - no Skyy_NodeIcon file is made for them

nodes.shows: the shrine with teal speed lines + a wing (allies in your zones move faster)

nodes.name: Follow
nodes.effect: Sanctuary moves with you at half speed
nodes.shows: the shrine moving after its Priest (a blue follow arrow)

nodes.name: Chain
nodes.effect: Sacred Heal on an ally inside Sanctuary also heals everyone else inside for 25%
nodes.shows: a heal cross inside the shrine spreading to everyone inside

nodes.name: Sanctified Mana
nodes.effect: allies inside your Sanctuary refill Mana 4% faster per rank
nodes.shows: the shrine + a mana crystal and plus (allies inside refill Mana faster)

nodes.name: Ward
nodes.effect: when Sanctuary ends, everyone inside keeps a ward of 3% of max Health per rank (5s)
nodes.shows: the shrine + a white ward shield (everyone inside keeps a ward when it ends)

nodes.name: Efficiency
nodes.effect: Sanctuary costs -8% Mana per rank
nodes.shows: the shrine + a mana crystal with a violet down arrow (costs less Mana)

nodes.name: Radiant Beacon
nodes.effect: allies inside your Sanctuary deal +2% damage per rank
nodes.shows: the shrine, a sword + an orange up arrow (allies inside deal more damage)

nodes.name: Holy Land
nodes.effect: Sanctuary holds 2 charges, so 2 can stand at once; allies where they overlap heal 150%, and nobody inside can be knocked back
nodes.shows: two Sanctuary shrines whose rings overlap + a heart (capstone: 2 charges; the overlap heals 150%)
